style: The Tides Guild beneath the City: dark slate stone with a sea-green tint, aged brass, deep teal cloth, and the guild emblem - a golden trident rising above two waves. Props follow the Throne Hall paintings (hall_pillar, wall_torch, city_banner) for the ink-and-painterly look; floor pieces follow the guild floor (raidfloor).
referenceNote: Props flattened onto #d6d2ca with a 40 px margin (the cutouts carry colour under zero alpha); ref_floor is the centre of assets/models/maps/raidfloor.png.
processing: Alpha scaled from its 254 cap to 255, haze below 6 dropped, tight crop at alpha>0. The marker was LANCZOS-resized to 256 px wide and the stairs to 672 px wide (they are drawn 42 and 164 units wide); the rest keep their native pixels. No repainting.

guild_pillar.png.use: 7 around the hall rim (east half mirrored so the torch faces the hall) and 4 in the battle arena; its painted torch flickers through CityScenery.paintedFlame on patch [.76,.33,.99,.425]

guild_torch.png.use: 6 on the corridor walls; the top 22.5% (the fire) sways like the Throne Hall wall torch

guild_banner.png.use: 2 on the north wall and 2 in the battle arena

guild_seal.png.use: the hall floor centre (radius 322) and the battle arena floor (squashed to perspective); a radial shade settles it into the dim hall

guild_stairs.png.use: the stair up to the City at the corridor foot (164 wide at x 1018, y 2422); opaque
